post.description: For a missed webhook (or local dev without one). Applies Paystack's answer exactly as the webhook would: a successful charge pays the checkout; money that can no longer be applied (checkout expired, cancelled or already paid, or the amount differs) becomes ORPHANED and is refunded automatically. Repeating it returns the payment. 409 PAYMENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE when Paystack is down.

The payment must be SUCCEEDED; an ORPHANED payment can only have its balance refunded (to retry a failed automatic refund). With orderId: a CANCELLED order on this payment, refunded its price plus its share of the service fee (delivery is not refunded). Without: the payment's remaining balance, refused while any order on the checkout has a pending or paid payout. Paid back in the payment's currency through Paystack; status becomes PROCESSED when Paystack confirms, or FAILED if Paystack refuses (ask again to retry). An unknown outcome stays PENDING until Paystack reports it. 409 PAYMENT_NOT_REFUNDABLE, ORDER_NOT_REFUNDABLE, ORDER_ALREADY_REFUNDED, NOTHING_TO_REFUND, REFUND_EXCEEDS_BALANCE, ORDERS_PAID_OUT.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, login (email/password or Google), token refresh, password reset, the signed-in user, and their name, phone and avatar.

tags.name: Locations
tags.description: Nigerian states and LGAs for the location dropdowns. Public; no token needed.

tags.name: Farmers
tags.description: Farmer profiles. A farmer sets and uploads their ID here before they can create a farm.

tags.name: Farms
tags.description: A farmer's own farms. Creating a farm sends it for verification by an agent in its LGA; its produce stays hidden from buyers until an agent verifies it.

tags.name: Produce
tags.description: Produce listings. Farmers manage their own; everyone else sees published listings on verified farms.

tags.name: Cart
tags.description: A buyer's cart and checkout. Adding to the cart reserves nothing; checkout reserves the stock and places unpaid orders under one checkout. A guest keeps the cart on the device, prices it with POST /cart/quote and merges it after sign-in with POST /cart/items/bulk.

tags.name: Addresses
tags.description: A buyer's saved delivery addresses, up to 20. The first becomes the default; a placed checkout keeps the address it was placed with.

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Paying for a checkout through Paystack, in naira or dollars. The checkout becomes PAID when Paystack confirms the charge. Admins can re-check a payment and issue refunds.

tags.name: FX
tags.description: The naira-per-dollar rate, with the margin already applied, for showing and charging prices in USD. Public; no token needed.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Buyers place orders; farmers confirm, prepare (with a checklist) and mark them ready. Either side can cancel within its limits.

tags.name: Sourcing Requests
tags.description: A buyer asks LAICOS to source produce that is not listed. Buyers create requests and read their own; each starts UNDER_REVIEW.

tags.name: Agents
tags.description: An extension agent's own profile, ID and cluster (the farms they manage). Usable before an admin verifies the agent.

tags.name: Verifications
tags.description: Farm verification tasks assigned to the calling agent: the on-site checklist, evidence photos, and the approve / reject / decline decision. Verified agents only.

tags.name: Handovers
tags.description: The step between a farmer marking an order READY and logistics collecting it. The agent whose cluster holds the farm checks the goods (verify), then records who took them (complete), which ships the order. Verified agents only.

tags.name: Messages
tags.description: Text conversations between an order's buyer and its agent, one per order. Open from payment until the order is fulfilled or cancelled, then read-only. Live updates arrive over socket.io at /v1/chat (WebSocket transport, auth: { token: <Firebase ID token> }): message.created carries a Message, conversation.read carries a ConversationReadEvent.

tags.name: Bank accounts
tags.description: Where a farmer's payouts go. A farmer sets their own; an agent can set one for a farmer in their cluster. The account is checked with Paystack, and any change holds the farmer's payouts for 24 hours.

tags.name: Payouts
tags.description: Paying farmers for fulfilled, paid orders once the hold period has passed. Farmers see their own payouts; admins see who is due and send them as one Paystack bulk transfer.
